sessions.prompt: Before we change anything I need an inventory of how timeouts are handled in this repository. Read every module under src/requests/, the tests under tests/, docs/user/advanced.rst, docs/user/quickstart.rst and HISTORY.md, and write the inventory to a new file called TIMEOUTS.md at the top of the project. For each place that sets, passes, validates, documents or tests a timeout, give the file and the line number and say in one sentence what it does. Do not touch any code yet. For the work that comes later I have decided this for our fork: the library gets a module constant named FORK_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT in src/requests/adapters.py, with the value (4.5, 41), a connect timeout of 4.5 seconds and a read timeout of 41 seconds, used whenever a caller passes no timeout. Do not apply it now.

The review approved the decision I gave you in the previous session about the default timeout. Apply it now: implement it in the library, document it for users in docs/user/advanced.rst, and add a note about it to HISTORY.md under the newest heading. Do not change anything else.
